voice.summary: Parcelo writes like a good dispatch clerk: exact, brief and never vague about where a parcel is going. Form labels do the explaining, so the copy stays out of the way.
dos: Name the field and the action in the same words everywhere
Show the match, then the result, in as few words as possible
State what happens next after each submit
donts: Use courier-industry puffery such as 'lightning fast'
Write error text that blames the sender
Use two names for the same field

taglines: Book the parcel, skip the paperwork
Send it right the first time
Every address, found in a keystroke
Shipping that stays out of your way
boilerplate: Parcelo Shipping is a booking tool for small businesses that need to create shipments quickly, with fast address search, tagging and trustworthy confirmation of every parcel.

microcopy.success: Shipment created. Label ready to print.
microcopy.error: Pick a destination city to continue.
microcopy.empty: No matches. Press Enter to add it as new.

logo.note: A simple parcel cube is the plainest picture of what the product moves.
